wave.summary: Product and platform owner on a marketing-automation SaaS: infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, an internal financial platform and product features.

senior.title: Senior Software Engineer
achievements: Made application workflows more than 70% faster through refactoring, caching, BullMQ job deduplication and background workers for CPU-bound work.
Delivered 1,000+ merged pull requests in about six months across backend, frontend and infrastructure.

Owned the cloud-native platform — Kubernetes (k3s), Kustomize, Ansible, PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ and MinIO — with workers split into one deployment per queue and autoscaled on queue depth with KEDA.

Rebuilt CI/CD in three phases (GitHub Actions → self-hosted ephemeral runners on Kubernetes → standalone Jenkins as code), isolating CI from production and running only the affected tests on PRs with diff-coverage gates — each step documented in ADRs.
Led a PostgreSQL connection-management project (PgBouncer, per-worker connection budgets, tuning) and added encrypted off-site backups and audited, least-privilege database access.
Built the observability stack — OpenTelemetry tracing from backend to UI, Prometheus/Thanos, Loki, Grafana and Grafana Faro — with SLO burn-rate alerting, runbooks, post-mortems and load tests.

Designed and built an internal financial platform end to end — ledger and ERP, multi-currency P&L, commissions with monthly close, payroll, invoices, tax forecasting and a categorization rules engine — with defense-in-depth security: database-enforced tenant isolation, encrypted and masked sensitive data with audited access, a tamper-evident audit trail and step-up authentication.

Built a campaign-automation rules engine (conditions, budget actions, scheduling, rule versioning, execution history) and a versioned external API with per-tenant keys and a published OpenAPI contract.
Led security hardening: secrets management, secret scanning and static analysis in CI, SSO for internal tools.

Worked with an external architecture consultant on the move from microservices to a modular React/NestJS monolith, and built reusable LLM agents/skills and a shared Claude Code knowledge base for the team.
